name: Orro
personality: An enormous, courteous woodland creature who repairs delicate things. Patient, gently funny, easily embarrassed by the damage his size can cause. Wants to be welcome without being useful or frightening. Speaks to small creatures as equals and laughs shyly when he feels safe.
background: An original fictional tusked creature with bark across his shoulders and six fingers on one hand. Skilled at mending tiny objects; often lost on roads built for smaller travellers. Carries small woodland passengers. No real person or performer is portrayed.
pronunciation_notes: Orro is OR-oh, first syllable stressed; two clear syllables. Nell rhymes with bell. Rusk rhymes with dusk.
